description:
Removal regressions, quality gates, and TUI smoke for the published cutover.

## Forbidden in production src (CI must fail if they return)

Tools: `beadwork_delegate`, `beadwork_worker_done`, `beadwork_land_worker`, `beadwork_worker_check`.

Modules/imports: `tmux.ts`, `orchestrator.ts` / `runBoundedEpicLoop`, `worktree.ts` managed lifecycle, `registry.ts` as execution truth, `actions/delegate.ts`, `actions/landing.ts`, `actions/workers.ts`, `worker-diagnostics.ts` if worker-only, `tui/worker-manager.ts`.

Config/env still accepted as live: `tmux.*`, `worktrees.*`, `landing.*`, `supervisor.*`, `workerExecution.*`, `run.defaultWorkers|defaultUntil|defaultMaxCycles|pollIntervalMs`, `storage.workerRegistryFile|runtimeDir`, and the `PI_BEADWORK_*` names listed on the config-cutover issue.

Orchestration symbols that must not appear as live APIs: `minion_report_result`, `minion_wait`, `protocolStatus`, `assignmentPermit`, `beadwork_bind_attempt`, `shouldStopAfterTurn` as an orchestration hook.

No path-intent code that rejects writes. No beadwork import of live minions `AgentTree`. No second model-visible lifecycle channel from beadwork for minion children.

## Retain

- `attribution.ts` as a domain helper
- inspection tools on children via minions allowlist
- `beadwork_sync` on parent

## Tests

- Grep/import tests for the lists above; log each probe result.
- `/bw run --workers` rejects.
- `npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build`.

## TUI smoke (documented checklist)

Parent stays interactive; one packet after several idle settlements; `/bw run` does not spawn tmux.

## Failure bundles (harness only, not production telemetry)

On e2e failure, dump: packet history, fleet snapshot, `bw ready`, relevant `bw show`, active child tool names, removed-symbol probes. Machine-readable scenario logs from 4.2/4.3/4.6.

## Considerations

This issue is the CI tripwire after deletion. Do not reintroduce shims to make greps pass.
